typeProperties.script:
source(useSchema: false,
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	moveFiles: ['/bronze/moves/load','/bronze/moves/archive'],
	format: 'delimited',
	fileSystem: 'apmt-elz',
	folderPath: 'bronze/moves/load',
	columnDelimiter: ',',
	escapeChar: '\\',
	quoteChar: '\"',
	columnNamesAsHeader: true) ~> CSV
CSV select(mapColumn(
		each(match(true()),
			regexReplace(trim(toString($$)),`[\[\]\uFEFF]`,'') = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> cleanHeaders
cleanHeaders select(mapColumn(
		each(match(true()),
			case(in(['unit nbr','unit no','unit number'],lower(toString($$))),'Unit Number',in(['mve gkey','mve_gkey','move key','move gkey'],lower(toString($$))),'Move Gkey',in(['ufv gkey','ufv_gkey'],lower(toString($$))),'UFV Gkey',lower(toString($$))=='facility id','Facility ID',lower(toString($$))=='complex id','Complex ID',lower(toString($$))=='yard id','Yard ID',lower(toString($$))=='event type id','Event Type ID',lower(toString($$))=='category id','Category ID',lower(toString($$))=='freight kind id','Freight Kind ID',lower(toString($$))=='container line id','Container Line ID',lower(toString($$))=='berth id','Berth ID',lower(toString($$))=='shipper id','Shipper ID',lower(toString($$))=='consignee id','Consignee ID',lower(toString($$))=='commodity id','Commodity ID',lower(toString($$))=='qc che id','QC CHE ID',lower(toString($$))=='put che id','Put CHE ID',lower(toString($$))=='carry che id','Carry CHE ID',lower(toString($$))=='fetch che id','Fetch CHE ID',lower(toString($$))=='put che operator id','Put CHE Operator ID',lower(toString($$))=='carry che operator id','Carry CHE Operator ID',lower(toString($$))=='fetch che operator id','Fetch CHE Operator ID',lower(toString($$))=='t_carry_complete','Carry Complete Time',lower(toString($$))=='t_put','Put Time',lower(toString($$))=='t_fetch','Fetch Time',lower(toString($$))=='t_dispatch','Dispatch Time',lower(toString($$))=='t_discharge','Discharge Time',lower(toString($$))=='t_carry_dispatch','Carry Dispatch Time',lower(toString($$))=='t_carry_fetch_ready','Carry Fetch Ready Time',lower(toString($$))=='t_carry_put_ready','Carry Put Ready Time',lower(toString($$))=='dist_carry','Carry Distance',lower(toString($$))=='dist_start','Start Distance',lower(toString($$))=='to_pos_gkey','To Position Gkey',lower(toString($$))=='fm_pos_gkey','From Position Gkey',lower(toString($$))=='active_ufv','Active UFV',lower(toString($$))=='pow','POW',lower(toString($$))=='goods and ctr wt kg','Goods and Container Weight Kg',toString($$)) = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> aliasHeaders
aliasHeaders assert(expectTrue(hasColumn('Unit Number') && hasColumn('Facility ID') && hasColumn('Complex ID') && hasColumn('Yard ID') && hasColumn('Carrier Visit Key') && hasColumn('Carrier Service') && hasColumn('Event Type ID') && hasColumn('Move Kind') && hasColumn('From Location') && hasColumn('To Location') && hasColumn('From Position Name') && hasColumn('To Position Name') && hasColumn('QC CHE ID') && hasColumn('QC CHE Kind') && hasColumn('Unit POD') && hasColumn('Carry Complete Time') && hasColumn('Put Time') && hasColumn('Fetch Time') && hasColumn('Dispatch Time') && hasColumn('Carry Dispatch Time') && hasColumn('Carry Fetch Ready Time') && hasColumn('Carry Put Ready Time') && hasColumn('Twin Fetch') && hasColumn('Twin Carry') && hasColumn('Twin Put') && hasColumn('Category ID') && hasColumn('Freight Kind ID') && hasColumn('Container Line ID') && hasColumn('Container Line Role') && hasColumn('POW') && hasColumn('Berth ID') && hasColumn('Requires Power Flag') && hasColumn('OOG Flag') && hasColumn('ATA') && hasColumn('Deck Logic') && hasColumn('Carry Distance') && hasColumn('Start Distance') && hasColumn('From Position Gkey') && hasColumn('Move Gkey') && hasColumn('UFV Gkey') && hasColumn('Goods and Container Weight Kg') && hasColumn('Active UFV') && hasColumn('Rehandles') && hasColumn('Shipper ID') && hasColumn('Commodity ID') && hasColumn('Consignee ID') && hasColumn('Put CHE ID') && hasColumn('Put CHE Operator ID') && hasColumn('Put CHE Kind') && hasColumn('Carry CHE ID') && hasColumn('Carry CHE Operator ID') && hasColumn('Carry CHE Kind') && hasColumn('To Position Gkey') && hasColumn('Restow Reason') && hasColumn('Discharge Time') && hasColumn('Fetch CHE ID') && hasColumn('Fetch CHE Operator ID') && hasColumn('Fetch CHE Kind') && hasColumn('ATD'), false, 'requiredColumns', null, 'Required columns present'),
	fail: true) ~> checkColumns
checkColumns derive({Unit Number} = toString(byName('Unit Number')),
		{Facility ID} = toString(byName('Facility ID')),
		{Complex ID} = toString(byName('Complex ID')),
		{Yard ID} = toString(byName('Yard ID')),
		{Carrier Visit Key} = toLong(byName('Carrier Visit Key')),
		{Carrier Service} = toString(byName('Carrier Service')),
		{Event Type ID} = toString(byName('Event Type ID')),
		{Move Kind} = toString(byName('Move Kind')),
		{From Location} = toString(byName('From Location')),
		{To Location} = toString(byName('To Location')),
		{From Position Name} = toString(byName('From Position Name')),
		{To Position Name} = toString(byName('To Position Name')),
		{QC CHE ID} = toShort(byName('QC CHE ID')),
		{QC CHE Kind} = toString(byName('QC CHE Kind')),
		{Unit POD} = toString(byName('Unit POD')),
		{Carry Complete Time} = toString(byName('Carry Complete Time')),
		{Put Time} = toString(byName('Put Time')),
		{Fetch Time} = toString(byName('Fetch Time')),
		{Dispatch Time} = toString(byName('Dispatch Time')),
		{Carry Dispatch Time} = toString(byName('Carry Dispatch Time')),
		{Carry Fetch Ready Time} = toString(byName('Carry Fetch Ready Time')),
		{Carry Put Ready Time} = toString(byName('Carry Put Ready Time')),
		{Twin Fetch} = toString(byName('Twin Fetch')),
		{Twin Carry} = toString(byName('Twin Carry')),
		{Twin Put} = toString(byName('Twin Put')),
		{Category ID} = toString(byName('Category ID')),
		{Freight Kind ID} = toString(byName('Freight Kind ID')),
		{Container Line ID} = toString(byName('Container Line ID')),
		{Container Line Role} = toString(byName('Container Line Role')),
		POW = toString(byName('POW')),
		{Berth ID} = toString(byName('Berth ID')),
		{Requires Power Flag} = toString(byName('Requires Power Flag')),
		{OOG Flag} = toString(byName('OOG Flag')),
		ATA = toString(byName('ATA')),
		{Deck Logic} = toString(byName('Deck Logic')),
		{Carry Distance} = toInteger(byName('Carry Distance')),
		{Start Distance} = toInteger(byName('Start Distance')),
		{From Position Gkey} = toLong(byName('From Position Gkey')),
		{Move Gkey} = toLong(byName('Move Gkey')),
		{UFV Gkey} = toLong(byName('UFV Gkey')),
		{Goods and Container Weight Kg} = toString(byName('Goods and Container Weight Kg')),
		{Active UFV} = toLong(byName('Active UFV')),
		Rehandles = toString(byName('Rehandles')),
		{Shipper ID} = toString(byName('Shipper ID')),
		{Commodity ID} = toInteger(byName('Commodity ID')),
		{Consignee ID} = toString(byName('Consignee ID')),
		{Put CHE ID} = toShort(byName('Put CHE ID')),
		{Put CHE Operator ID} = toString(byName('Put CHE Operator ID')),
		{Put CHE Kind} = toString(byName('Put CHE Kind')),
		{Carry CHE ID} = toInteger(byName('Carry CHE ID')),
		{Carry CHE Operator ID} = toString(byName('Carry CHE Operator ID')),
		{Carry CHE Kind} = toString(byName('Carry CHE Kind')),
		{To Position Gkey} = toLong(byName('To Position Gkey')),
		{Restow Reason} = toString(byName('Restow Reason')),
		{Discharge Time} = toString(byName('Discharge Time')),
		{Fetch CHE ID} = toInteger(byName('Fetch CHE ID')),
		{Fetch CHE Operator ID} = toString(byName('Fetch CHE Operator ID')),
		{Fetch CHE Kind} = toString(byName('Fetch CHE Kind')),
		ATD = toString(byName('ATD'))) ~> typedColumns
Aggregate1 derive(t_carry_complete = coalesce(toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Carry_Complete_Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_discharge = coalesce(toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Discharge_Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		Fetch_CHE_Id = toLong({Fetch_CHE_ID}),
		QC_CHE_Id = toLong({QC_CHE_ID}),
		Put_CHE_Id = toLong({Put_CHE_ID}),
		Carry_CHE_Id = toLong({Carry_CHE_ID}),
		Year = year(t_put),
		Month = month(t_put),
		Week = weekOfYear(t_put),
		t_dispatch = coalesce(toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Dispatch_Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_dispatch = coalesce(toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Dispatch_Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_fetch_ready = coalesce(toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Fetch_Ready_Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_carry_put_ready = coalesce(toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Carry_Put_Ready_Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ATD = coalesce(toTimestamp({ATD},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATD},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({ATD},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATD},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({ATD},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATD},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATD},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({ATD},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATD},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ATA = coalesce(toTimestamp({ATA},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATA},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({ATA},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATA},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({ATA},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATA},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATA},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({ATA},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({ATA},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		mve_gkey = toLong(mve_gkey),
		Carrier_Visit_Key = toLong({Carrier_Visit_Key})) ~> DataTypeConversion
Select2 select(mapColumn(
		each(match(true()),
			regexReplace($$,' ','_') = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 aggregate(groupBy(mve_gkey),
	each(match(name!='mve_gkey'), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate1
derivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		each(match(/* All input columns */true()),
			/* Input name */$$ = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
select3 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
typedColumns derive({Carrier Visit Key} = toLong({Carrier Visit Key}),
		mve_gkey = toLong({Move Gkey}),
		t_put = coalesce(toTimestamp({Put Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Put Time},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Put Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Put Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Put Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Put Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Put Time},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Put Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Put Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		t_fetch = coalesce(toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'),toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'dd-MM-yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'dd.MM.yy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'dd/MM/yyyy\'T\'HH:mm:ss'), toTimestamp({Fetch Time},'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		ufv_gkey = toLong({UFV Gkey})) ~> derivedColumn1
DataTypeConversion select(mapColumn(
		mve_gkey,
		Unit_Nbr = Unit_Number,
		Facility_Id = Facility_ID,
		Yard_Id = Yard_ID,
		Carrier_Visit_Key,
		Event_Type_Id = Event_Type_ID,
		Move_Kind,
		From_Location,
		To_Location,
		From_Position_Name,
		To_Position_Name,
		Carry_CHE_Operator_Id = Carry_CHE_Operator_ID,
		Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id = Fetch_CHE_Operator_ID,
		Put_CHE_Operator_Id = Put_CHE_Operator_ID,
		Fetch_CHE_Id = DataTypeConversion@Fetch_CHE_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Kind,
		Carry_CHE_Id = DataTypeConversion@Carry_CHE_Id,
		Carry_CHE_Kind,
		Put_CHE_Id = DataTypeConversion@Put_CHE_Id,
		Put_CHE_Kind,
		QC_CHE_Id = DataTypeConversion@QC_CHE_Id,
		QC_CHE_Kind,
		t_carry_complete,
		t_put,
		t_fetch,
		t_dispatch,
		t_discharge,
		t_carry_dispatch,
		t_carry_fetch_ready,
		t_carry_put_ready,
		dist_carry = Carry_Distance,
		dist_start = Start_Distance,
		Twin_Fetch,
		Twin_Carry,
		Twin_Put,
		Category_Id = Category_ID,
		Freight_Kind_Id = Freight_Kind_ID,
		Restow_Reason,
		POW,
		ufv_gkey = Aggregate1@ufv_gkey,
		Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg = Goods_and_Container_Weight_Kg,
		Requires_Power_Flag,
		OOG_Flag,
		ATA,
		ATD,
		Rehandles,
		Year,
		Month,
		Week,
		POD = Unit_POD,
		Deck_Logic
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> select3
AlterRow1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'apmt-elz',
	folderPath: 'silver/moves',
	mergeSchema: false,
	autoCompact: true,
	optimizedWrite: true,
	vacuum: 0,
	deletable: false,
	insertable: false,
	updateable: false,
	upsertable: true,
	keys:['mve_gkey'],
	umask: 0777,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		mve_gkey,
		Unit_Nbr,
		Facility_Id,
		Yard_Id,
		Carrier_Visit_Key,
		Event_Type_Id,
		Move_Kind,
		From_Location,
		To_Location,
		From_Position_Name,
		To_Position_Name,
		Carry_CHE_Operator_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id,
		Put_CHE_Operator_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Id,
		Fetch_CHE_Kind,
		Carry_CHE_Id,
		Carry_CHE_Kind,
		Put_CHE_Id,
		Put_CHE_Kind,
		QC_CHE_Id,
		QC_CHE_Kind,
		t_carry_complete,
		t_put,
		t_fetch,
		t_dispatch,
		t_discharge,
		t_carry_dispatch,
		t_carry_fetch_ready,
		t_carry_put_ready,
		dist_carry,
		dist_start,
		Twin_Fetch,
		Twin_Carry,
		Twin_Put,
		Category_Id,
		Freight_Kind_Id,
		Restow_Reason,
		POW,
		ufv_gkey,
		Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg,
		Requires_Power_Flag,
		OOG_Flag,
		ATA,
		ATD,
		Rehandles,
		Year,
		Month,
		Week,
		POD,
		Deck_Logic
	)) ~> sink1
